title: party.stash
description: Several games (MULTI_GAME_PLAN §4.7, D5, MG5): before a region.start, move every party member into Cobblemon's PC (the first free slots), so the new story's starter has room and nothing is lost. Answered by act.result{kind:"stash", moved} (S→C), or error{code:"stash.pc_full"} with nothing moved.

region.description: The region whose game is about to start.
